AchievementType = Course.Description: A Course is a course of study that, typically, has a shared curriculum although it may be taught to different students by different teachers. It is likely that several classes of a single course may be taught in a term.  For example, a school runs Grade 9 English in the spring term. There are four classes, each with a different 30 students, taught by 4 different teachers. However the curriculum for each of those four classes is the same – the course curriculum.
AchievementType = Course.Name: AchievementType = Course

creditsAvailable.Description: Credit hours associated with this entity, or credit hours possible. For example 3.0.
creditsAvailable.Name: creditsAvailable

level.Description: Grade(s) for which the class is attended. The permitted vocabulary should be defined as part of the adoption and deployment process. See the Implementation Guide [OR-IG, 20] for more details on how to define/use such a vocabulary.
level.Name: level

awardedDate (or issuanceDate).Description: Timestamp of when the credential was awarded. issuanceDate is used to determine the most recent version of a Credential in conjunction with issuer and id. Consequently, the only way to update a Credental is to update the issuanceDate, losing the date when the Credential was originally awarded. awardedDate is meant to keep this original date.
awardedDate (or issuanceDate).Name: awardedDate (or issuanceDate)

evidence.Description: A description of the work that the recipient did to earn the achievement. This can be a page that links out to other pages if linking directly to the work is infeasible.
evidence.Name: evidence

expirationDate.Description: If the credential has some notion of expiry, this indicates a timestamp when a credential should no longer be considered valid. After this time, the credential should be considered expired.
expirationDate.Name: expirationDate

image.Description: The image representing the credential for display purposes in wallets.
image.Name: image

proof.Description: If present, one or more embedded cryptographic proofs that can be used to detect tampering and verify the authorship of the credential.
proof.Name: proof

identifier.Description: Other identifiers for the recipient of the achievement. Either id or at least one identifier MUST be supplied.
identifier.Name: identifier

result.Description: The set of results being asserted.
result.Name: result

address.Description: The street address. For example, 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy.
address.Name: address

addressCountry.Description: The country. For example, USA. You can also provide the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
addressCountry.Name: addressCountry

addressLocality.Description: The locality. For example, Mountain View.
addressLocality.Name: addressLocality

targetUrl.Description: The URL of a node in an established educational framework. When the alignment is to a CASE framework and the CASE Service support the CASE JSON-LD binding, the URL should be the 'uri' of the node document, otherwise the URL should be the CASE Service endpoint URL that returns the node JSON.
targetUrl.Name: targetUrl

description.Description: A longer description of the evidence.
description.Name: description

id.Description: The URL of a webpage presenting evidence of achievement or the evidence encoded as a Data URI. The schema of the webpage is undefined.
id.Name: id

type.Description: The value of the type property MUST be an unordered set. One of the items MUST be the IRI 'Evidence'.
type.Name: type

description.Description: A short description of the individual or organization
description.Name: description

email.Description: A contact email address for the individual or organization.
email.Name: email

id.Description: An institution's student identifier for the person, learner, publisher, issuer.
id.Name: id

sourcedID.Description: The individual's or organization's unique 'sourcedId' value, which is used for providing interoperability with other identity systems.
sourcedID.Name: sourcedID

telephone.Description: Primary phone number for the individual or organization.
telephone.Name: telephone

LetterGrade.Description: The result is a letter grade
LetterGrade.Name: LetterGrade

CreditsAvailable.Description: When Achievement Type = Degree, then the credits available are the possible credits one could earn in their program/degree.
CreditsAvailable.Name: CreditsAvailable

Tag.Description: One or more short, human-friendly, searchable, keywords that describe the type of achievement when achievementType = Assessment
Tag.Name: Tag

achievementType.Description: The achievement is an assessment if the achievementType = Assessment
achievementType.Name: achievementType

creator.Description: The person or organization that created the achievement definition.
creator.Name: creator

creditsAvailable.Description: Credit hours associated with this entity, or credit hours possible. For example 3.0.
creditsAvailable.Name: creditsAvailable

criteria.Description: Criteria describing how to earn the achievement.
criteria.Name: criteria

description.Description: A short description of the achievement.
description.Name: description

fieldOfStudy.Description: Category, subject, area of study, discipline, or general branch of knowledge. Examples include Business, Education, Psychology, and Technology.
fieldOfStudy.Name: fieldOfStudy

humanCode.Description: The Subject part of the humanCode  (Subject + Catalog #)
humanCode.Name: humanCode

name / description.Description: The name and description of the achievement when the achievementType = competency
name / description.Name: name / description

otherIdentifier.Description: Use otherIdentifier for the course section ID.
otherIdentifier.Name: otherIdentifier

specialization.Description: Name given to the focus, concentration, or specific area of study defined in the achievement. Examples include 'Entrepreneurship', 'Technical Communication', and 'Finance'.
specialization.Name: specialization

tag.Description: One or more short, human-friendly, searchable, keywords that describe the type of achievement, when achievementType = Course
tag.Name: tag

Issuer.Description: A description of the individual, entity, or organization that issued the credential.
Issuer.Name: Issuer

expirationDate.Description: If the credential has some notion of expiry, this indicates a timestamp when a credential should no longer be considered valid. After this time, the credential should be considered expired.
expirationDate.Name: expirationDate

issuanceDate.Description: Timestamp of when the credential was issued.
issuanceDate.Name: issuanceDate

targetType.Description: The type of the alignment target node.  In this case it would be a targetType of CTDL.
targetType.Name: targetType

achievedLevel.Description: If the result represents an achieved rubric criterion level (e.g. Mastered), the value is the id of the RubricCriterionLevel in linked ResultDescription.
achievedLevel.Name: achievedLevel

resultDescripton.Description: An achievement can have many result descriptions describing possible results. The value of resultDescription is the id of the result description linked to this result. The linked result description must be in the achievement that is being asserted.
resultDescripton.Name: resultDescripton

resultType.Description: The type of result this description represents. This is an extensible enumerated vocabulary.
resultType.Name: resultType

valueMax.Description: The maximum possible value that may be asserted in a linked result.
valueMax.Name: valueMax

valueMin.Description: The minimum possible value that may be asserted in a linked result.
valueMin.Name: valueMin

description.Description: Description of the rubric criterion level.
description.Name: description
